email.subject: Next step: schedule your technical interview with Halcyon Systems
email.body:
Hello,

Good news! The Halcyon Systems hiring team has reviewed your application for Backend Engineer and would like to move you to the technical interview stage.

Please choose a 60-minute slot that suits you using the scheduling page below. Slots are available over the next two weeks.

Book your interview: https://hireflow.example.com/schedule/h7k2p9

If none of the times work, reply to this email and we'll find another option.

Thanks,
The Halcyon Systems Recruiting Team
